# Interferon signature — magnitude and significance (faithful report)

Differential expression highlighted antiviral activation. STAT1 was upregulated 8-fold (Table 5). IRF7 was significant with pvalue=0.0002 (Table 5).

By contrast, SOCS1 was downregulated 8-fold (Table 5). CXCL10 was upregulated (Table 5).
